description: Fetch tweets that mention a specific Twitter/X user (i.e. tweets containing @userName). Useful for brand monitoring, sentiment tracking on a public figure, or finding conversations involving an account. Supports time-bound queries via sinceTime/untilTime (Unix seconds). Paginates via cursor.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor; omit for first page (~20 per page).

sinceTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) lower bound — only mentions after this time. Omit for no lower bound.

untilTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) upper bound. Omit for no upper bound.

userName.description: Twitter/X screen name without @ — fetches tweets that mention this user (@userName).

name: get_user_mentions
title: Get Mentions of a User
